record.paper_title: Model Theory of Tame Valued Fields and Beyond: Recent Developments and Open Questions
record.context_brief: Complete axiomatization and decidability of F_p((t))
record.original_question: Let p be a prime and F_p the field with p elements. Let F_p((t)) denote the field of formal Laurent series over F_p, equipped with the t-adic valuation v_t (which assigns to each nonzero series the smallest exponent with nonzero coefficient). The decidability of the elementary theory of Q_p (the p-adic numbers) in the language L_val of valued rings has been known since 1965 (Ax-Kochen, Ershov). It is known that the L_val(t)-elementary axiom system (A_t) consisting of 'henselian defectless valued field of positive characteristic with value group a Z-group with smallest positive element v(t) and residue field F_p' is not complete (Kuhlmann 2001). What can be said about the model theory of F_p((t)) in L_val? In particular, is there a complete axiomatization of the L_val-elementary theory of F_p((t)), and is this theory decidable?

evidence.quote: Open problem 8: What can we say about the model theory and in particular a complete axiomatization and the decidability of F_p((t))?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $p$ be a prime number and let $\mathbb{F}_p$ denote the finite field with $p$ elements. Consider the field $\mathbb{F}_p((t))$ of formal Laurent series in one variable over $\mathbb{F}_p$, equipped with the $t$-adic valuation $v_t$, which assigns to a nonzero series $\sum_{n\ge n_0} a_n t^n$ (with $a_{n_0}\ne 0$) the integer $n_0$, and which satisfies $v_t(0)=\infty$. View $\mathbb{F}_p((t))$ as a structure in the language $L_{\mathrm{val}}=\{+,-,\cdot,0,1,\mathcal{O}\}$ of valued rings, where $\mathcal{O}$ is a unary predicate naming the valuation ring $\mathbb{F}_p[[t]]$.

It is known that the $L_{\mathrm{val}}(t)$-axiom system $(A_t)$ asserting "henselian defectless valued field of characteristic $p$, value group a $\mathbb{Z}$-group with smallest positive element $v(t)$, and residue field $\mathbb{F}_p$" does not axiomatize a complete theory.

Questions:
(a) Provide a complete recursive axiomatization of the $L_{\mathrm{val}}$-elementary theory $\mathrm{Th}(\mathbb{F}_p((t)))$.
(b) Determine whether $\mathrm{Th}(\mathbb{F}_p((t)))$ is decidable.
artifact.status_search_result: The decidability and complete axiomatization of the elementary theory of $\mathbb{F}_p((t))$ in the language of valued rings is a well-known longstanding open problem in the model theory of valued fields in positive characteristic. Recent seminars and surveys (e.g., a UPenn seminar titled "Two longstanding open problems in positive characteristic, Part II: On decidability of F_p((t))") confirm the problem remains open.

status_evidence.title: Two longstanding open problems in positive characteristic, Part II: On decidability of F_p((t))
status_evidence.snippet: Seminar explicitly framing the decidability of F_p((t)) as a longstanding open problem.

status_evidence.title: Undecidable Problems: A Sampler (Poonen)
status_evidence.snippet: Survey discussing decidability questions including those for fields of Laurent series in positive characteristic.
status_evidence.claim: The status of the elementary theory of F_p((t)) is listed among open decidability questions.
